blocks.text: Joyfold carries the folded form of shared celebration into everyday care. What once required a room, preparation, and many hands now appears as a small tied decoration; its value still comes from use in a living relationship.
An irregular blue paper rosette bound with copper wire, small ivory pennant folded inside.
One-shot activation: Copper tie springs free, the paper rosette unfolds and three tiny pennants unfurl. The game performs the final fade.
18 silver. Stress severity −1; reaching zero clears the condition. Happiness +8; Health +3. Recovery timers become 75% of their remaining time; Potion Boost gives +1 to skills for 5 minutes.

Original PixelLab artwork and opening animation, October 28, 2026. Generation 248b1e8b-6688-4faa-a57f-1b5fcb9840a1; animation fb4584f0-ad5c-45c0-b4f6-bf6c3bc58a41. The game performs the final fade; reduced motion holds a still.
